title: Internal equivariant module sheaves and their sectionwise additive category
statement:
Fix compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention] and a small site $(C,J)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $K:C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Grp}$ be a group presheaf and $R:C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Ring}$ a ring presheaf with values in the coefficient universe. For a presheaf of $R$-modules $M$ [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], a natural linear $K$-action consists of homomorphisms $K(U)\to\operatorname{End}_{R(U)}(M(U))$ of monoids such that restriction of $a\cdot m$ equals the restricted group section acting on the restricted module section. An equivariant module presheaf is such a pair $(M,a)$. Its morphisms are restriction-natural sectionwise linear maps commuting with the actions. These maps form the additive subgroup of the ordinary module-presheaf maps cut out by equivariance, with identity, composition, zero, addition and negation inherited from the underlying maps. This is the specified preadditive structure.

For a sheaf of rings $S$ on $(C,J)$, define $\mathcal E_K(S)$ as the full subcategory of equivariant module presheaves over $S$ whose underlying module presheaf is a sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with the inherited addition. Define its forgetful functor to $\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ by retaining the underlying module sheaf and every component map; likewise forget actions on presheaves. For a commutative ring sheaf, its base ring sheaf is obtained by forgetting only commutativity. In particular, when $K$ is a sheaf of groups this defines internal equivariant module sheaves with trivial coefficient action: each group section acts $S(U)$-linearly and does not act on coefficients. No nontriviality, surjectivity or nonzero-ring assumption is imposed.
